top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined caregiver does not have high school diploma or high school equivalent certificate.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Changing Location or Address (26 TAC §747.301(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not notify Licensing/CCR of change of temporary address due to plumbing problems in the home.
